name: Reject_4
short_caption: The robot extends its right arm outward in a dismissive, rejecting gesture before returning to a neutral pose.
movement_description: The robot begins by raising its right arm to chest level, bending the elbow and keeping the hand relaxed. It then sweeps the right arm outward to its side in a firm, direct motion while slightly tilting its head to the left, away from the hand. Finally, it lowers the arm back down to its side, returning to a neutral standing posture.
safety_notes: The right arm sweeps outward to the side; ensure adequate lateral clearance on the robot's right side.
